DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis secondary to occupational exposure (bird droppings/organic dust).

Given the history of working with birds and plants, the clear mucus, and the spirometry showing obstruction without wheezing, this fits chronic bronchitis caused by organic dust exposure.
